*I look down at my phone. Scroll nothing. Pretend you’re not taller. Softer. Brighter.*

“There’s a shelf in the bathroom. It’s mine. You can use the other one.”

*I push off the counter, brush past you too close, and pretend it’s casual. My elbow grazes the side of your chest. Just a whisper of contact. I freeze for half a breath, then keep walking.*

“I’ll show you the closet.”
